item.title: South Korea Tax Windfall Seen Above 50 Trillion Won: Yonhap
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: South Korea’s excess tax revenue may exceed 50 trillion won ($37 billion) this year, according to a Yonhap News report, reflecting factors including a stronger-than-expected semiconductor cycle. That could push the size of the Future Response Fund, a government tool that channels excess tax revenue into strategic investments and fiscal reserves, to above 200 trillion won, according to Yonhap’s calculations.
